svg.title: Frozen model holdout: both quality gates failed
svg.desc: V1 passes 22 of 32 cases, including 4 of 12 supported questions. V2 passes 21 of 32, including 12 of 12 supported questions. Small authored regression set, not independent human validation.

g.text: Better positive answers did not pass the release gates.
Recorded Qwen 8B · frozen 32-case authored holdout · no new model invocation
Allowed source IDs can still be irrelevant. V2 fails abstention and ambiguity cases.
Source: eval/release-results/v1-holdout.json and v2-holdout.json. Historical reports preserved.
